title: ione racemosa
intro: Ione racemosa, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ione racemosa include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which make it useful in treating wounds, fever, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
